title: The Greedy Forwarding Constructor
prompt: The forwarding constructor in the starter hijacks direct-initialization copies. Constrain it with a `requires` clause so `Tracked c{src};` routes to the **copy** constructor, while `Tracked d("placed");` still forwards.

tests.name: direct-init copy routes to the copy ctor
tests.hint: Add requires (!(std::same_as<std::decay_t<A>, Tracked>) && ...) before explicit — a Tracked lvalue then can't match, so the copy ctor wins.

tests.name: string literal still forwards
tests.hint: A const char array decays to char*, which is not Tracked — the constraint leaves normal construction alone.
